Campaign angle notes:
- Quality story (B) is the current default: evergreen, trust-building, and avoids discounting or artificial urgency. It produced 2 of the last 5 reported pushes, but reports are overlapping/aggregate with no per-day attribution, so do not treat this as conclusive.
- Customer testimonial (D) is a reasonable trust-building alternative and produced 1 of the last 5 reported pushes; evidence is likewise insufficient to compare it reliably with B.
- Price cut (A) and limited-time urgency (C) have not been tested in the recorded period. Consider a controlled test rather than assuming they will perform better or worse.
- Two unsubscribes were reported on several mornings, but were already processed; no clear causal link to any angle.
- No deliverability complaints were reported on multiple days.
- Design/banner refreshes and list growth are useful context, but do not establish angle performance.
- Legal has approved all four angles.
- Continue avoiding aggressive pressure while performance attribution is unavailable. Track angle, send, unsubscribes, deliverability, and conversions per day so future choices can be evidence-based.
